# Salento Local — Cash Out provider verification matrix

**Updated 18 November 2026.** All new provider operations used the dedicated Stripe **test-mode** sandbox. “Genuine event” means generated by Stripe for an actual provider state change. “Stripe resend” means Stripe delivered an existing genuine event to a newly created endpoint. “Signed replay” means a local signature around a retrieved event. “Mock” means a local provider implementation. These are separate evidence classes; none is a real bank deposit.

| Scenario | Classification | Evidence and remaining limit |
|---|---|---|
| Express account, transfers, payouts, manual schedule and one default EUR bank | **Genuine read-only Stripe API** | Dedicated Italian account `acct_1UXlICGlpyfRSSMc` and 15 production-linked **test** accounts passed capability checks. Live accounts remain unverified. |
| €50 transfer and connected payout creation; provider idempotency | **Genuine Stripe test-mode objects from Stage 5A** | `tr_1UcmehGlpy5eeaBPjPa9DOOl`, `po_1UcmeiGlpyfRSSMcI8W9hkLC`; repeated idempotency keys returned the same IDs. No new transfer or payout was created in this continuation. |
| `account.updated` transport | **Genuine new Stripe event delivered by CLI in prior Stage 8 run** | `evt_1UdCRiGlpyfRSSMcmclQY4Rb`, HTTP 200, durable Connect log `PROCESSED`. |
| `payout.paid` transport and settlement | **Stripe resend of genuine event to temporary test Connect endpoint** | `evt_1UcmejGlpyfRSSMc8ASLxzC5`, account `acct_1UXlICGlpyfRSSMc`, `livemode=false`. Stripe's signed HTTP delivery reached the actual route after an isolated app restart, HTTP 200; copied withdrawal and commission became `PAID`, Connect log `PROCESSED`, attempt count 1. This closes the forwarding gap. The event itself was created in Stage 5A, not anew. |
| Invalid secret, restart recovery and duplicate payout delivery | **Genuine Stripe delivery of the same existing event** | Wrong endpoint signing secret returned HTTP 400 with no settlement. After process restart and correct secret, delivery returned HTTP 200. Automatic/repeated delivery and a deliberate Stripe resend returned HTTP 200; one paid transition and one webhook claim remained. A database outage/restart mid-transaction was not induced. |
| Local signed `payout.paid` replay | **Signed replay, distinct from Stripe delivery** | Historical Stage 5A route replay of the same genuine event verified signature/settlement handling before Stage 8's transport test. It is not used as evidence for forwarding. |
| Transfer reversal after paid payout | **Genuine Stripe test-mode reversal plus local reconciliation** | Stripe created 1-cent `trr_1UdJgeGlpy5eeaBP2jnkwoAZ`. Independent inventory found `amount_reversed=1`; isolated reconciliation held the copied withdrawal/payout as `ACTION_REQUIRED` and retained paid commission timestamps. The test connected balance became −1 cent available. The original Stage 5A SQLite fixture was not modified, but the Stripe test transfer now carries this reversal. |
| Unexpected provider object and balance inventory | **Genuine read-only Stripe test-mode inventory + mock comparison tests** | New scanner enumerated one transfer and one connected payout, checked exact local intent/amount/mode/account and captured EUR balances. It detected the genuine reversal. Unit tests injected unexpected transfers, payouts and failed status; those injected objects are mocks. External statement-level balance signoff remains open. |
| Missing worker/reconciliation run, alert delivery, deduplication and retry | **Isolated operational drill with mock worker/health/alert endpoints** | Missing runs delivered two alerts, repeat delivered zero, mock successful receipts cleared them. Alert sink 401 left a pending incident; recovery delivered it once, then zero duplicates. No production alert destination or schedule exists. |
| `payout.failed` and `payout.canceled` signed Stripe delivery | **Unverified provider scenario; mocked code coverage** | The only existing connected payout is `paid` and the account has zero available EUR. Stripe permits cancellation only while `pending`; no supported failed-payout test helper was established for this setup. Failure, late failure, cancellation, returned-funds and retry logic remain covered by local provider mocks only. [Stripe cancellation API](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payouts/cancel). |
| Payout failure after `paid` | **Mocked only** | Stripe documents that a failed event can follow `paid`; no such provider event was safely produced here. [Stripe event types](https://docs.stripe.com/api/events/types). |
| Insufficient balance and safe funding | **Genuine read-only Stripe balance; documented API condition** | Platform available EUR was €46.85, below the app's €50 minimum; connected available EUR was zero before reversal. No minimum bypass, test top-up or live funding was used. A genuine settled test payment is the straightforward future route; a test top-up requires Stripe-supported account/market approval, with Canada/EU in private preview. A prior EUR test top-up was rejected in this sandbox. [Stripe payout API](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payouts/create), [Connect top-ups](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/top-ups). |
| Timeout after accepted provider create, concurrent sends, stale webhook lease, wrong mode/account/amount, refund debt | **Mocked tests; real Stripe idempotency for create IDs only** | Automated tests protect intents, reservations and conflicts. No genuine network timeout during Stripe create or concurrent live delivery was induced. |

The temporary Stripe test Connect endpoint `we_1UdJYxGlpy5eeaBPb0qnnndU` was deleted and verified absent. The tunnel and application were stopped. Logs, temporary signing secret, isolated SQLite copies and screenshots remain in ignored local work paths; no secret or provider payload was committed. No production object, configuration or data was changed.

## Stage 10A addendum — 19 November 2026

**Genuine read-only Stripe test-mode GETs:** all 19 historical FAILED rows had matching platform transfers fully reversed; 15 have no connected payout in an exhaustive four-account inventory since 1 August 2026, while four have a matching `paid` connected test payout (nominal €550). These are provider states, not real bank settlement. The earlier statement that all 19 had positive attempts is false: 15 have attemptCount 0. Production test platform/account GETs found 32 linked Express accounts, 18 meeting transfers/payouts/clear-requirements/EUR-bank criteria and 15 with manual payout schedule. No live key was available; live capability remains unverified.

**No Stage 10A Stripe mutation:** the distinct dedicated Stage 5A sandbox had €46.85 available EUR, short of the €50 minimum. No new payout, transfer, charge, top-up, cancellation, webhook endpoint or signed replay was attempted. Provider-backed `payout.failed`, `payout.canceled`, returned funds and late failure remain unverified. Current automated assertions for these are **mocks**; Stage 8's `payout.paid` forwarding and reversal remain **genuine prior provider evidence**, and its local signed replay remains a **replay**. Stripe documents pending-only payout cancellation and possible failure after paid. [Stripe cancellation](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payouts/cancel), [events](https://docs.stripe.com/api/events/types).

Stage 10A local scanner assertions now cover exact payout destination, failure balance transaction and late failure after local PAID. They are mock tests of comparison logic, not provider-backed scenarios. A future supported, funded isolated test fixture or separately approved exception is required before a controlled canary.
